headline: Q2FY27 Result Review

highlights: Catering segment profit therefore slipped ~4% despite the sales boom, while internet ticketing that earns ~80% of segment profit at a ~84% margin, grew just 1%YoY (revenue INR ~3.9bn, profit INR ~3.3bn).
Tourism was the bright spot, with revenue up 28% and profit up ~32%.
The headline damage came from a one- off INR 1.16bn Rail Neer provision (GSTAT anti-profiteering order) that pulled PAT down 23% to INR 2.64bn and EPS to INR 3.29 from INR 4.28.
Sequentially it is better than it looks as EBITDA rose 5.5% QoQ and margin recovered 237bps from 28.2%.
valuation: TP Rs 550 CMP Rs 471 Potential upside/downside 17% Previous Rating BUY Key Stock Data Bloomberg / Reuters IRCTC IN /INIR.BO Sector MISC.
watch: The risks are a material rise in receivables since March, a fall in H1 operating cash flow and INR 204mn of disputed ITC claims.
